prerequisites: Per acting role: fictional parent, secret sub, minor owner, plural sub and lone Entities with fixture Holdings 75/25 and 40/35; three fixture Contracts (open and Confidential with Our entity = parent, open with Our entity = secret sub).
Priya Raman as the comparison Legal Team Member; the other of Nadia Haddad/Daniel Okafor as the reader without a Grant.
scenarios.expected: Corporate facts and graph edges are accurate and explicit Grants control the intended reach. Restricted linked records remain protected; a Holding or chart relationship does not grant access.
scenarios.actual: As the acting role, Nadia Haddad: Authorized shares saved on focus change and Issued shares with Enter; Escape abandoned 999; "-5" and "12.5" showed "Enter a whole number of zero or more." and 10000 stayed; a cleared Issued shares saved blank. Par value was disabled until Currency GBP; 1.25 saved, 1.255 showed "Enter a non-negative amount with up to 2 decimal places.", and changing Currency to EUR kept 1.25. The Chart drew parent→secret sub 75% solid, minor owner→secret sub 25% dashed, parent→plural sub 40% solid and minor owner→plural sub 35% dashed (highest percentage primary below 50%); the lone Entity was unconnected on a row below all connected nodes. Drag panned, the wheel zoomed, ArrowRight panned by 40, plus zoomed, zero and Fit to window returned the fitted view. A single click and Space highlighted the ownership chain; Clear highlight and Escape cleared it; double-click and Enter opened the Entity. The parent's Contracts tab listed both fixture Contracts for Nadia Haddad; Priya Raman saw only the open one with the count "1 linked Contract", and the Confidential Contract returned 404 for her. Manage access opened Confidential access; Person offered no Business Users or archived users; Grant access listed Priya Raman beside Nadia Haddad. The Confidential switch saved on, Priya opened the Entity, and Daniel Okafor (Administrator) (no Grant) could not open it, found it absent from List search, saw "Restricted Entity" without a link on the parent's Owned Entities, saw a "Confidential Entity" chart box with no name or link, and was refused a self-grant; being linked as an Officer and opening a Contract whose Our entity is that Entity did not give access (the Contract showed "Restricted Entity"). Removing Priya withdrew her access while the Holding stayed; removing the last person showed "Grant another person access before removing the last person from a confidential entity.". Turning the switch off let Daniel Okafor (Administrator) and Priya open the Entity without Grants. After Nadia Haddad removed her own Grant on an open Entity, its switch was disabled and Manage access was absent. As the reader without a Grant in the other run, Nadia Haddad saw the switch disabled and no Manage access on Daniel's open Entity.
